CustomField.description: BRD Contact Cadence: User-facing field showing when next contact attempt is scheduled. Used for agent visibility in list views and reports. Calculated based on BRD cadence: Day 0, 5, 35, 65, 95.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date when next contact attempt is scheduled. Based on BRD contact cadence (Day 5, 35, 65, or 95 from case creation).
CustomField.label: Next Contact Due
